confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Valletta, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation (especially July peak-season hostel and hotel rates) and cocktail prices are less certain. EUR-to-USD conversion assumes roughly 1.15 USD per EUR. FX: the 0.6955 figure for 15 October 2026 (4.00 pm) came from search-result summaries attributing it to the RBA; I did not independently read the RBA table, so verify it against the official F11 series.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is general Maltese and southern European island-capital pricing in the euro area, with Valletta's tourist-season premium for accommodation and central-venue drinks. Not based on a single named comparable city.
